idea-plugin.name: Zeus
idea-plugin.description: Zeus Theme is a dark UI theme for JetBrains IDEs, built on top of the default dark interface and refined using the Zeus color palette. The theme transforms the original Zeus color scheme into a full-featured UI theme, extending the palette beyond the editor to cover panels, tool windows, popups, navigation elements, and system components. Based on the standard JetBrains dark theme, Zeus Theme focuses on visual consistency, balanced contrast, and comfortable long-term use across the entire IDE.
